text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
My legs feel heavy, like I'm trudging
through a
swamp all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: We... That's right. I'm not alone anymore.
choice_data_list: また、スズカらしい走りを見せてほしい

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you. I'm... I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I see... How can I win if I'm not running
my own
way?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll run my way in
the next
race.
